text: I've been waiting over an hour for a callback so I'm writing it down. My grandson is 5 months. His temp was 38.7 earlier. His eczema has flared up, dry itchy patches on his arms and cheeks. Between doses of Calpol he's playing and babbling away, he's taking his milk normally and his breathing is normal. He was flopped on the sofa a little while ago and gave me a turn, but he's just worn out after a long day. He woke up as soon as I touched him and started chatting at me. I'd just like someone to tell me what to put on the eczema and how to manage the temperature, that's all.
